title: Salesforce Center of Excellence Architect
description:
**Hello Visionary,**

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

**We are looking for job title :** Salesforce Center of Excellence Architect

**You’ll create impact by**

* Defining and evolving the enterprise Salesforce architecture, ensuring it aligns with business strategy, enterprise systems, and long‑term scalability goals.
* Crafting and leading end‑to‑end Salesforce solutions across multiple clouds, including Sales, Service, Experience, Marketing, and Analytics Cloud.
* Establishing architectural standards, governance, and procedures within the Salesforce Center of Perfection (CoE) to ensure secure, high‑performing, and scalable implementations.
* Reviewing and guiding Salesforce solutions to ensure architectural compliance, handle technical debt, and reduce complexity across a multi‑org environment.
* Defining integration and data strategies, enabling flawless connectivity between Salesforce and enterprise systems such as ERP, data platforms, and marketing tools.
* Partnering with business and technical participants to translate sophisticated business requirements into clear, effective, and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Driving innovation and continuous improvement, staying ahead of with Salesforce releases and new technologies, while mentoring teams and promoting standard processes across the organization.

**You’re excited to build on your existing expertise, including**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of hands‑on experience with Salesforce, designing and implementing enterprise‑scale solutions across multiple clouds in large, multi‑org environments.
* Strong architectural leadership and governance experience, including defining roadmaps, standards, and conducting develop reviews within a Salesforce CoE or similar structure.
* Deep expertise in Salesforce integrations and data architecture, using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware such as MuleSoft, alongside solid experience in data modeling, migration, and governance.
* Excellent knowledge of Salesforce development and configuration standard processes, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, declarative tools, and Agile delivery methods.
* Demonstrable ability to communicate effectively in English with C-level participants is critical, enabling clear articulation of technical concepts, business value, and transformation roadmaps.
* A proactive, growth‑oriented approach, with demonstrated leadership, mentoring capabilities, and the ability to perform optimally in a fast‑paced, global environment.
* Salesforce architect‑level certifications (Application Architect and/or System Architect) are strongly preferred.

**Join us and be yourself!**

This role, based in Pune /Bangalore / Mumbai, is an individual contributor position. You may be required to visit other locations within India and internationally. In return, you'll have the opportunity to work with teams shaping the future.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

**About Signify**

  
  

Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.

  
  

At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.

  
  

Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.

  
  

**More about the role**

  
  

**SAP Integration Technical Engineer**

  
  

Signify is amid the design, build and deployment of a global greenfield S/4HANA solution. To support the deployment and ensure stable operations and continuous optimization, we are establishing a global application maintenance organization.

The **SAP Integration Technical Engineer** is responsible for operational support in S/4 HANA deployments and developing, supporting, and optimizing integration solutions across SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BTP, cloud applications, third-party systems, and B2B/3PL partners in a post go-live application maintenance environment. Collaborates within a global team and works closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure stable, scalable, secure, and compliant end-to-end data exchange. The role focuses on technical interface design, issue resolution, system stability, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**

* Support technical integration delivery aligned to the global template and deploy the global S/4 HANA implementation on a local level while providing technical support for legacy SAP ECC and SAP PI/PO interfaces where required.
* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain integration flows (iFlows) using SAP Integration Suite on SAP BTP (CPI), API Management, Event Mesh, and SAP PI/PO 7.5 Single Stack.
* Provide end-to-end technical support in an AMS environment including incident management, service requests, defect resolution, root cause analysis (RCA), and interface debugging in line with agreed service levels.
* Manage B2B/EDI and A2A integrations (including EDIFACT, ANSI X12, and XML) over secure protocols (AS2, SFTP, VANs, HTTPS, APIs) for global EDI onboarding and 3PL/carrier integration.
* Conduct technical impact analysis, unit testing, and regression testing to ensure quality delivery of interface changes, enhancements, and custom Groovy scripting.
* Monitor CPI iFlows, PI/PO channels, IDocs, ABAP Proxies, API traffic, queues, and background scheduling frameworks to ensure operational continuity.
* Support migration activities of legacy SAP PI/PO interfaces to SAP Integration Suite on BTP and participate in custom interface remediation.
* Collaborate with Functional Consultants (across SD, FI, MM, PP, BW, O2C, MTO, and Logistics domains), Basis, Security, and external suppliers to resolve cross-system issues.
* Maintain comprehensive integration documentation, mapping standards, naming conventions, and operational runbooks to support governance and knowledge sharing.

  

**Critical Experiences and Skills**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience in building, troubleshooting, and tuning end-to-end integration flows using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI), SAP Cloud Connector, Groovy Scripting, REST/SOAP APIs, and legacy SAP PI/PO 7.5 platforms.
* Strong technical expertise in SAP BTP Integration Suite, Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, Event Mesh, and Cloud Connector configurations.
* Extensive experience with SAP integration protocols and technical objects including IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs, ABAP Proxies, OAuth, SSL Certificates, and IAS/IPS security.
* Experience in B2B/EDI integrations, handling EDI standards (EDIFACT, ANSI X12, XML) and external 3PL/WMS/carrier integrations.
* Experience working in a global application maintenance support or production support environment including stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong understanding of SAP functional domain dependencies and logistical processes, particularly Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Make-to-Order (MTO).
* Good understanding of non-SAP integration platforms (e.g., IBM Sterling, Boomi, MuleSoft) and exposure to AI tools like SAP Joule is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* SAP Integration Suite certification is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, complex and highly integrated business environment.

**Grading Differentiators**

* Good knowledge of SAP Integration architecture, BTP services, security models, and ITIL-aligned incident management practices.
* Operates independently within assigned technical scope and delivers with limited supervision.
* Able to resolve moderately complex technical and interface issues across integrated SAP and non-SAP landscapes.
* Contributes effectively to support, enhancement, architectural compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. **Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1752082

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**

  

**Experience Level - 15+**

  

**Job Description**

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.

We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.

  

**Role Details**

  

**Key responsibilities include:**

**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.

title: Director, Software Engineering | Enterprise AI Platforms, Infrastructure & Automation
description:
Meet the Team
  
In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms& Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.
  
Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As the Director of AI Support& Automation, you will build and lead our Bangalore-based engineering pod as an elite 'player-coach' calibrated two levels below the VP. Combining direct architectural leadership with deep, hands-on systems development across MyAgent and Circuit, you will set the benchmark for AI platform reliability and quality.
  
You will enable the engineering organization to improve and optimize engineering processes and infrastructure, directing software systems development, application engineering, and software quality assurance for cloud-based and agentic AI platforms. Your directive spans across 5 core pillars:
  

* Pillar 1: Tier 3 Engineering& Escalated Platform Support: Act as the ultimate engineering escalation authority for MyAgent and Circuit. Lead hands-on debugging, root-cause forensic analysis, and kernel/runtime patch development for complex production failures, memory leaks, context bleed, and tool execution anomalies. Bridge the gap between SRE/L2 operational support and core platform architecture with zero-regression hotfix.
* Pillar 2: Premier AI Agent Test Harness& Evaluation: Architect and build an end-to-end, agent-driven test automation harness. Implement automated LLM-as-a-judge scoring frameworks, multi-agent simulation loops, deterministic task verification, and golden dataset benchmarking. Maintain uncompromising quality gates with >99% test pass rates across complex functional, regression, experimental, and safety workflows.
* Pillar 3: AI Software& GPU Performance Validation: Lead performance profiling, stress testing, and concurrency load and latency validation across dedicated on-premise GPU clusters and cloud runtimes. Optimize latency, token throughput, context cache utilization, and resource efficiency.
* Pillar 4: Modular SDK& API Developer Platform: Deliver modular, embeddable SDKs, React components, and headless APIs that empower thousands of Cisco software engineers to control, customize, and extend multimodal agentic experiences.
* Pillar 5: High-Talent-Density Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and lead a small, high-density pod (6–10 elite systems, AI, and test automation engineers) in Bangalore. Lead by example through daily code reviews, technical design RFCs, pair programming, and rigorous engineering craftsmanship.
* Technical Architecture& Testing Methodology:
* Deterministic Harness Layer: Unit and integration verification of MCP protocol compliance, tool schema validation, state machines, token exchange (RFC 8693), and memory storage persistence.
* LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation Framework: Automated scoring pipelines using calibrated frontier and on-premise judge models to evaluate grounding, factual accuracy, safety guardrails, hallucination rates, and task completion against versioned golden sets.
* Multi-Agent Simulation& Adversarial Red-Teaming: Automated agent swarms generating synthetic edge cases, malicious prompt injections, tool misuse attempts, and context overflow scenarios to proactively identify failure modes.
* Continuous Canary& Regression Pipeline: Automated staging deployment validation with automated rollback mechanisms, real-time latency tracing (OpenTelemetry), and semantic drift monitoring.

Minimum Qualifications
  

* Education: Bachelor's degree (B.Tech / B.E. / B.S.) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative STEM discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 3+ years leading high-performing technical engineering teams and 2+ years of hands-on production experience with LLMs, agentic workflows, or AI platforms.
* Hands-on Coding Proficiency: Expert-level fluency in Python and modern TypeScript/JavaScript; strong working proficiency in Go, C++, or Rust for systems-level performance tuning.
* AI& Systems Architecture: Deep practical experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, Triton Inference Server, PyTorch, and vector databases.
* Modern Test& Performance Engineering: Demonstrated track record of designing large-scale distributed test harnesses, performance testing tools (k6, Locust, JMeter), browser automation (Playwright), and AI evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, Promptfoo, Eval Studio).

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Advanced Credentials: Master's degree (M.Tech / M.S.) or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering from a premier tier-1 engineering institution or top global research universities).
* GPU& Infrastructure Acumen: Solid understanding of GPU compute infrastructure, CUDA memory management, high-density server configurations, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Academic, Research, or Open Source Contributions: Demonstrated academic depth or research contributions in distributed systems, compiler optimization, GPU parallel computing (CUDA/Triton), formal software verification, major contributions to tier-1 open-source AI frameworks/benchmarks, or recognized technical patents in AI/systems engineering.
* Player-Coach Leadership Archetype: Proven ability to lead from the front, write production code, conduct deep architectural reviews, and inspire an elite engineering culture without relying on bureaucratic middle management.
* Enterprise Executive Communication: Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence, interact, and present technical architectures effectively across engineering, product, and executive leadership.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

title: Lead Solutions Architecture Engineer
description:
Overview:

**Atlassian Architect**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Manager, Atlassian Products

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Senior/Principal

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – is the connective tissue of how work gets planned, tracked, and executed across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Atlassian Architect is the highest-level individual contributor on the Atlassian Products team, responsible for defining platform architecture, setting technical standards, and solving the most complex problems in HealthEdge's Atlassian environment. This is not an administration role – it is a design and engineering role. You will own the decisions that shape how the platform is built, governed, and extended, and your work will directly influence how thousands of employees across the company plan, collaborate, and deliver. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, the Architect will also shape the platform's AI readiness — ensuring the architecture supports Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo at enterprise scale.

You will serve as the technical authority for the Atlassian Products team – providing architectural guidance, mentoring Senior and regular Administrators, leading complex solution delivery, and acting as the primary point of escalation for problems that require deep platform expertise. You will also own strategic initiatives including instance governance, automation frameworks, API integrations, and migration or consolidation efforts.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Platform Architecture & Standards**
-------------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform architecture across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Access – defining how these tools are structured, governed, and extended at scale
* Establish and maintain technical standards for project design, workflow architecture, permission models, field configuration, and Confluence space taxonomy across the organization
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions that balance user needs with platform health – avoiding configuration sprawl and technical debt
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities, product roadmap changes, and Marketplace apps – assessing fit, risk, and adoption strategy
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation including design decisions, standards references, and solution blueprints

**Complex Solution Design & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Lead discovery and solution design for the most complex stakeholder requests – those that require cross-project thinking, advanced automation, or architectural changes
* Translate ambiguous business requirements from engineering, IT, product, and business functions into well-structured, scalable Atlassian solutions
* Deliver end-to-end implementation of high-complexity configurations, including multi-project workflow frameworks, advanced JSM service architectures, and cross-tool integrations
* Partner with the Manager, Atlassian Products to define and manage the platform improvement roadmap, sequencing initiatives by impact and feasibility

**Automation & Scripting**
--------------------------

* Design and implement advanced automation frameworks using native Jira/JSM automation and ScriptRunner (Groovy) for complex workflow logic, validators, post-functions, and listeners
* Build and maintain REST API integrations between Atlassian tools and external systems including identity platforms, ITSM tools, and business applications
* Establish automation standards and reusable patterns that the broader admin team can follow and extend
* Review and quality-assure automation and scripting work produced by Senior Administrators, providing technical guidance and improvement feedback

**Migrations & Consolidations**
-------------------------------

* Lead or architect Atlassian migration and consolidation projects, including instance-to-instance migrations, Server/Data Center to Cloud transitions, and post-merger platform integrations
* Perform pre-migration assessments including configuration audits, data mapping, and risk analysis
* Design migration runbooks and execute or oversee technical migration steps with appropriate rollback planning
* Ensure data integrity, permission continuity, and minimal disruption to end users throughout migration events

**Enterprise Governance & Security**
------------------------------------

* Own Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, authentication policies, IP allowlisting, and audit log management
* Design and enforce the organization-wide governance model for Atlassian – covering project creation standards, permission scheme governance, license management, and app approval processes
* Lead license optimization efforts, identifying consolidation opportunities and ensuring spend is aligned with actual usage
* Support security and compliance requirements including access reviews, data residency considerations, and audit evidence related to Atlassian platforms
* Serve as the technical lead for any Atlassian-related security incidents, misconfigurations, or compliance findings

**Team Mentorship & Technical Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the informal technical lead for the Atlassian Products team – the person Senior and regular Administrators bring their hardest problems to
* Mentor Senior Administrators on advanced configuration, automation, and solution design, actively developing their technical depth
* Conduct technical design reviews for significant platform changes proposed by team members
* Contribute to hiring by participating in technical assessments for Atlassian Administrator and Senior Administrator candidates
* Represent the Atlassian Products team in cross-functional technical forums and architecture discussions

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of deep, hands-on Atlassian platform experience with expert-level proficiency in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Atlassian architectures for large, complex organizations (thousands of users, dozens of teams)
* Expert-level proficiency in ScriptRunner (Groovy) scripting for advanced workflow customization, automation, and platform extensions
* Strong REST API experience with Atlassian platforms — building integrations, automating administrative tasks, and extending platform capabilities
* Proven experience leading Atlassian migrations or consolidation projects, including Cloud migrations
* Deep understanding of Atlassian Cloud security and governance including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and enterprise-scale permission management
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications strongly preferred – ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or Atlassian Certified Expert (ACE) designation
* Familiarity with how Atlassian platform architecture affects AI indexing quality and Rovo answer relevance
* Experience with advanced Marketplace apps at architectural scale (Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, Tempo)
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and applying them within JSM at an architectural level
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and DevOps tooling that integrates with Atlassian (AWS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT platform integration or multi-instance Atlassian consolidation

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have completed a thorough assessment of the current Atlassian environment, identified the top architectural gaps and technical debt priorities, and established yourself as the go-to technical authority on the team. Within six months, you have delivered at least one significant platform improvement, established or formalized key governance standards, and are actively mentoring the admin team. Within a year, the Atlassian platform at HealthEdge reflects clear architectural ownership — well-governed, well-documented, and built to scale — and you have meaningfully elevated the technical capability of everyone around you.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates at scale. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who wants to be the definitive technical expert on a platform that touches every part of the business. You'll have the backing of an engaged manager, a growing team of administrators to mentor, and a real mandate to shape how the platform evolves. If you want to do the most technically interesting Atlassian work of your career, this is that role.

title: Design Verification Engineer- AI Accelerator - Bangalore
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for talented Design Verification Engineers to help verify and deliver Velaura's next generation Physical AI SoC. You will work closely with architects, RTL engineers, software engineers and system teams to establish confidence in the correctness, performance, reliability and safety of the design, from individual RTL blocks through complete hardware and software systems running real workloads.

This role focuses on our AI acceleration units. We are designing custom compute engines from scratch to deliver industry leading inference performance at best in class energy efficiency, and every gain has to come inside a tight power envelope. You will own verification of the hardware that makes those numbers real, where correctness means numerical behavior as much as protocol.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own verification of Velaura's custom AI acceleration units including matrix and vector compute engines.
* Work with architects to understand the intent behind a newly designed microarchitecture and turn it into detailed test and coverage plans, including the criteria that define correctness for numerical hardware.
* Build verification environments using SystemVerilog, UVM, C and C++, with stimulus, checkers, assertions, trackers and coverage that stay portable across block and subsystem environments.
* Develop reference models for GEMM and GEMV operations and compare hardware results against them.
* Verify accelerator data flow including operand staging, tiling, accumulation and result writeback.
* Verify precision, rounding and quantization behavior against the architecture specification.
* Verify throughput, latency, utilization and performance per watt against aggressive targets under representative LLM and vision workloads.
* Execute regressions through design and environment bring up, track progress using bug and coverage metrics, and support emulation and pre silicon bring up with the compiler and runtime teams.

* 8 or more years verifying high performance compute or complex digital designs.
* High level understanding of LLMs including transformer structure and inference data flow.
* Knowledge of GEMM and GEMV operations and how they map onto hardware.
* Experience with SystemVerilog, UVM, C and C++, assertions and coverage driven verification.
* Experience building or using reference models in C, C++ or Python.
* Understanding of numerical formats and precision tradeoffs such as FP16, BF16, FP8 and INT8.
* Experience owning a block or unit of a design independently from test plan through coverage closure, including debug of complex failures.

title: LA- Azure Cloud Security Architect

Job Summary  
Looking for an experienced Azure Cloud Security Architect to design and implement secure Azure and hybrid infrastructure architectures aligned with Zero Trust and Secure by Design principles. The role focuses on network segmentation, internal traffic control, identity security, privileged access, infrastructure isolation, and enterprise security risk reduction.  
Key Responsibilities

. Implement network segmentation, east west traffic inspection, microsegmentation, workstation to workstation restrictions, and controls to prevent unauthorized lateral movement.  
. Define and enforce security zones across user, server, management, backup and recovery, virtualization, and privileged administration environments.  
. Strengthen identity security through Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory Tier 0 isolation, RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, MFA, and administrative segregation.  
. Design secure privileged administration using PAM, jump hosts, Privileged Administrative Workstations (PAWs), and controlled management plane access.  
. Implement isolation and security controls for backup and recovery environments, hypervisors, and vCenter infrastructure.  
. Establish cloud security governance using Azure Policy and Microsoft Defender for Cloud, with appropriate security monitoring and logging.  
. Develop a security architecture roadmap covering network segmentation, identity security, PAM, infrastructure isolation, and cloud security improvements.  
. Conduct security architecture assessments, identify risks, document mitigation measures and residual risks, and track remediation initiatives.  
  
Required Skills  
  
. 10–12 years of relevant experience in Azure cloud architecture, infrastructure security, or hybrid cloud security.  
. Strong hands on expertise in Azure networking, Azure Firewall, NSGs, routing, Private Endpoints, and hybrid connectivity.  
. Practical experience in network segmentation, east west traffic control, and lateral movement prevention.  
. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory security, Tier 0 isolation, RBAC, PIM, and privileged access controls.  
. Experience with PAM, jump host architecture, PAWs, backup network segregation, and virtualization security.

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

The Linux System and Hardware Administrator is the hands-on owner of day-to-day operations for Fulfillment IQ’s Linux servers and for the laptops and hardware used by our India-based team. The role sits in the Corporate Technology team within FIQ Group Shared Services, which supports both our services and product businesses. * Keep laptops and hardware for India-based staff set up, tracked, and working
* Handle routine Linux server administration using defined runbooks
* Resolve support tickets quickly and escalate what you cannot fix with clear notes
* Keep documentation, asset records, and ticket history accurate

* 3 to 5 years of system administration experience, including hands-on hardware and end-user support
* Strong Linux administration from the command line (Ubuntu or RHEL family): users and permissions, file systems, services, packages, and logs. Linux is non-negotiable for this role
* Experience setting up and troubleshooting web servers (Apache or Nginx) on Linux, with Bash scripting for routine tasks

* Collect, wipe, and reissue devices from leavers within agreed timelines
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate repairs and warranty claims with OEMs and local vendors

**Documentation & Improvement**

* Write simple scripts to automate repetitive tasks, reviewed by senior team members

* Reconcile the India asset register against active headcount
* Build working relationships with the Corporate Technology and DevOps teams

title: Senior Staff Security Architect
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Director, AI & Information Security

**Role Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Senior Staff Cyber Security Architect to design, implement, and govern security architecture across enterprise networks, endpoints, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and AI ecosystems. This role is critical to establishing security standards, driving secure-by-design initiatives, and ensuring our technology landscape remains resilient against evolving cyber threats. You will serve as a trusted technical leader, bridging business and technology to enable innovation through secure, scalable architecture.

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As a Senior Staff Architect, you will define and maintain the enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs. You will lead security reviews for infrastructure, cloud, SaaS, and emerging AI initiatives while enforcing Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust principles. Success in your first 6–12 months includes developing a cohesive security roadmap, establishing robust AI and cloud security guardrails, and partnering cross-functionally across Engineering, IT, and Product teams to reduce critical risks while elevating our overall security maturity.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Define and maintain** enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs across network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, and AI domains.
* **Architect and govern** secure cloud landing zones, security guardrails, and DevSecOps shift-left practices across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* **Establish and enforce** Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust Architecture principles, ensuring secure connectivity, micro-segmentation, and least-privilege access.
* **Lead the development** of our enterprise AI security strategy, establishing controls for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), model poisoning detection, and responsible AI governance.
* **Design** enterprise network and endpoint security architecture, overseeing standards for NGFW, ZTNA, EDR, MDM, and secure SD-WAN.
* **Oversee** SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) and establish comprehensive controls for enterprise platforms (e.g., M365, Salesforce, Workday).
* **Develop** robust Identity & Access Management (IAM) strategies, including SSO, MFA, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and passwordless authentication.
* **Conduct** comprehensive architecture reviews, threat modeling, and security assessments to identify risks and recommend strategic remediation to executive leadership.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with Engineering, Product, IT, and Legal teams to integrate security throughout the development lifecycle and align with regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
* **Provide architectural guidance** during major cyber incidents, partnering with SOC and Incident Response teams to evaluate events and strengthen future security controls.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of comprehensive cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years in a Security Architect or Lead Security Engineering role supporting enterprise-scale global environments.
* Deep technical expertise across network, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, and emerging AI security domains.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing Zero Trust Architectures and managing enterprise risk.
* Experience developing secure cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the courage and ability to influence cross-functional leadership on security best practices.
* **Education Requirements:** B.Tech/B.E. in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or GIAC.
* Cloud-specific security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience or certifications related to AI/LLM Security (e.g., CAISP) and data privacy (CIPP).
* Master's degree in a relevant technical or engineering field.

**Location**
  
Gurgaon/Bangalore, India — Hybrid / Remote

You will enable colleagues, copilots, and AI agents to access trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise knowledge, improving decision-making consistency and productivity.

You will help transform fragmented business information into reusable knowledge products with clear ownership, lineage, provenance, permissions, and controls.

You will provide technical leadership for enterprise knowledge platforms and retrieval capabilities that make business policies, procedures, controls, and operational knowledge AI-ready and safely consumable at scale.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Knowledge Platform Architecture:** Own the solution architecture and technical design of core knowledge platform capabilities, including ingestion, enrichment, knowledge graph, retrieval, and lifecycle management.

**Ontology & Semantic Architecture:** Lead the design and evolution of the enterprise ontology, semantic model, taxonomy, and metadata standards to create consistent knowledge across business domains.

**Enterprise Knowledge Products:** Architect and deliver high-quality, AI-ready knowledge products that transform unstructured business knowledge into trusted, governed, and reusable assets.

**Knowledge Governance & Guardrails:** Design and build governance and guardrail controls into the platform, including provenance, lineage, policy-aware access, classification, permissions, and auditability.

**Technical Leadership & Mentoring:** Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers and work with product owners, SMEs, and platform teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  

**Essential Skills:**

Deep expertise in knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, semantic modelling, taxonomy, and metadata management for enterprise-scale knowledge ecosystems.

Strong experience in unstructured data processing, document understanding, information extraction, entity resolution, and knowledge enrichment pipelines.

**RAG, GraphRAG & Retrieval:**

Hands-on expertise in RAG, GraphRAG, vector databases, search technologies, and retrieval optimisation for AI-powered knowledge systems.

Experience building enterprise search, recommendation, discovery, and knowledge marketplace capabilities is desirable.

**Knowledge Graph & Semantic Technologies:**

Hands-on experience with RDF, OWL, SKOS, SPARQL, ontology engineering, taxonomy management, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, and graph modelling concepts.

**Enterprise Knowledge Platform Architecture:**

Experience designing enterprise knowledge platforms with scalability, reliability, observability, security, and cloud-native architecture principles.

Ability to define reusable technical patterns and architecture across ingestion, enrichment, retrieval, knowledge graphs, governance, and lifecycle management.

**Knowledge Governance & Responsible AI:**

Strong understanding of knowledge governance, data governance, lineage, provenance, access control, compliance, classification, and auditability frameworks.

Experience designing AI guardrails, retrieval controls, policy-aware access mechanisms, and governance capabilities to ensure trusted and authorised knowledge consumption.

**GenAI & Agentic AI:**

Experience integrating LLM gateways, agent frameworks, AI platforms, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and model orchestration services.

Familiarity with agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, MCP patterns, and tool-based reasoning systems is desirable.

**Policy-as-Code & Decisioning:**

Ability to implement policy-as-code, executable knowledge, rules engines, and deterministic decisioning patterns to support explainable and compliant AI outcomes.

Experience with BPMN, DMN, policy engines, and executable knowledge is desirable.

**Programming Languages & Tools:**

Strong proficiency in Python as the primary programming language, along with TypeScript/Node.js and SQL for platform engineering, APIs, data pipelines, and AI integrations.

**Risk & Compliance:**

Knowledge of risk, compliance, regulatory, and control frameworks within a highly governed financial services environment is advantageous.

Understanding of process intelligence, process mining, business capability modelling, and decision modelling is desirable.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration:**

Strong technical leadership with the ability to establish engineering practices and mentor Staff and Senior Engineers.

Strong stakeholder engagement and product-thinking skills to translate business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

**It’s more than a career at NAB. It’s about more meaningful work, more global opportunities and more innovation beyond boundaries .**

Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you’ll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You’ll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities and grow your career.

NAB has established NAB Innovation Centre India as a centre for operations and technology excellence to support NAB deliver faster, better, and more personalized experience to customers and colleagues.

At NAB India, we’re ramping-up and growing at a very fast pace. Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.

### **The Opportunity**

This is a role for a visionary technical leader who operates as a strategic force multiplier for the entire engineering organization. As a Principal Platform Engineer (SDE4) at NAB, you will be responsible for setting the long-term technical vision for critical domains of our engineering platform. You will tackle our most complex and ambiguous challenges, pioneering innovative solutions that advance the state-of-the-art for financial technology at scale. Your influence will extend far beyond the Platform Engineering & Developer Experience teams; you will collaborate with senior technology leaders, establish engineering standards, and mentor other senior engineers, shaping the technical fabric of the bank. If you are driven by the challenge of solving large-scale distributed systems problems and have a passion for creating an environment where hundreds of engineers can thrive, this is your platform to make a lasting impact.

### **What You'll Do**

As a SDE4, your focus will be on strategy, architecture, and technical leadership, driving the long-term success and scalability of the NAB Engineering Foundation.

* **Define Technical Vision and Strategy:** Define and own the long-term technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for critical platform domains, such as our enterprise container platform, multi-cloud infrastructure strategy, or core developer experience. Your work will set the direction for years to come.
* **Architect for the Future:** Lead the architectural design of complex, cross-functional platform solutions. You will ensure these systems are secure, compliant, highly scalable, and cost-effective, anticipating future business needs and technological shifts.
* **Solve Ambiguous, Large-Scale Problems:** Tackle the most technically challenging and ill-defined problems within the platform space. This involves deep-dive analysis, prototyping, and creating novel solutions that push the boundaries of what's possible.
* **Champion Engineering Excellence:** Act as a steward for engineering quality across the orgs. You will establish and evangelize best practices, author design documents and RFCs, and lead by example to cultivate a culture of high-performance engineering.
* **Mentor and Elevate Senior Talent:** Serve as a mentor and technical guide to other senior engineers (SDE3s) and team leads. You will be a "force multiplier," elevating the technical capabilities of the entire organization through your guidance and expertise.
* **Collaborate with Senior Leadership:** Partner with senior technology leaders (Heads of Engineering) to align the platform strategy with NAB's overarching business and technology objectives, ensuring your work delivers maximum strategic value.

### **What You'll Bring**

We are seeking a world-class engineer with a history of strategic impact and a reputation for technical excellence and thought leadership.

* **Experience:** 9+ years of experience in software and platform engineering, with significant time spent in a technical leadership, staff, or principal engineer capacity.
* **Distributed Systems Mastery:** Deep, recognized expertise in designing, building, and operating large-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems on multi-cloud platforms (AWS and Google Cloud / Azure).
* **Cloud-Native Authority:** Mastery of Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem. You have architected and operated Kubernetes platforms at enterprise scale, likely in complex, multi-tenant environments, and have a profound understanding of its internals.
* **Strategic Influence:** Proven ability to drive large-scale, cross-team technical initiatives from conception through to production. You are adept at building consensus and influencing technical direction without direct authority.
* **Exceptional Communication:** World-class communication and interpersonal skills. You can crisply articulate highly complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, from junior engineers to executive leadership.
* **Visionary Mindset:** A strategic thinker who can look beyond immediate problems to anticipate future challenges and opportunities, translating them into a coherent technical strategy.
* **AI Innovation:** Lead organizational AI platform strategy and GenAI technology adoption. Design intelligent platforms with autonomous capabilities and predictive operations, like developer agents, code review agents, test agents, SRE agents etc.
* **Multi-** **Cloud architecture & Strategy:** You have experience in designing and architecting, multi-cloud / cross-cloud-platform systems, and defining clear strategies for maintaining multi-cloud infrastructure at scale.

* **Risk & Security:** As part of being a banking / financial institution, security and risk in ingrained in our daily activity. A key competency would be not just building great tech but also building with the best practices of security & risk ingrained in our decisions and strategies.

### **Good to Have**

These qualifications indicate a candidate operating at the forefront of the industry:

* Demonstrable experience in defining and implementing AI-driven platform capabilities.
* Active contributions to open-source projects within the cloud-native, infrastructure, or observability space.
* Deep expertise with advanced deployment strategies (e.g., canary, blue-green) and modern continuous delivery platforms like Harness, especially in the context of highly regulated financial workloads.
* Published work, such as conference talks, blog posts, or whitepapers, on topics related to platform engineering, distributed systems, or cloud architecture.

**A diverse and inclusive workplace works better for everyone:**

Our goal is to foster a culture that fills us with pride, rooted in trust and respect. NAB is committed to creating a positive and supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to embrace their true, authentic selves. A diverse and inclusive workplace where our differences are celebrated, and our contributions are valued. It’s a huge part of what makes NAB such a special place to be.

**More focus on you:**

We’re committed to delivering a positive experience for our colleagues and a workplace you can be proud of. We support our colleagues to balance their careers and personal life through flexible working arrangements such as hybrid working and job sharing and competitive financial and lifestyle benefits. We invest in our colleagues through world class development programs (Distinctive Leadership and Career Qualified in Banking), and empower you to learn, grow and pursue exciting career opportunities

This is your chance to join NAB India and along with your experience and expertise to help shape an innovation driven organisation that focuses on making a positive impact in the lives of its customers, colleagues and communities

* **Drive Practical AI Adoption:** Bring AI to life across the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements, architecture, and coding to code review, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and maintenance.

**About the Position:**
=======================

At Arctic Wolf, you won't just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve, you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We're proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights, and IDC MarketScape, but what matters most is the work behind it. We deliver real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora® Platform.
  
  
If you're looking for meaningful work, smart teammates, and the chance to make a real impact in a high growth company that's redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you.
  
  
Our mission is simple. End Cyber Risk. We're looking for an **Engineering Manager** to be part of making this happen.
  
  
**Position Overview and Objective**  
  
The Engineering Manager will contribute to our **Sensor Platform Delivery team** by leading the site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout functions that take our network security sensor platform from a passing build to a healthy, verified state across thousands of sensors deployed in customer environments worldwide.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
**AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER AT ARCTIC WOLF, YOU WILL:**

* Lead the engineering teams across site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout for our network security sensor platform.
* Own release criteria and rollout decisions for firmware, kernel, and service updates across our global sensor fleet, including staged rolling deployments and rollback calls.
* Drive fleet reliability targets, including availability, upgrade success rate, and data flow continuity, across multi region cloud infrastructure on AWS.
* Oversee the physical lab environment, including build servers, power distribution units (PDUs), and virtualized test fleets, keeping lab configuration aligned with production.
* Manage CI/CD pipelines and automated test frameworks spanning unit, integration, simulation, and full physical system testing, and reduce flaky tests to improve signal quality.
* Partner with infrastructure and security teams on container orchestration, database management, and core networking protocols, including TCP/IP and port mirroring, to support sensor telemetry and detection workflows.
* Build and maintain the runbooks, dashboards, and on-call processes that your team, solution engineers, and solution architects depend on during incident response.
* Mentor and grow a team of engineers, strengthening people management practices and cross functional partnership with solution engineering managers and solution architects.

**Experience and Requirements**  
  
**YOUR EXPERIENCE MIGHT LOOK LIKE:**

* 10- 15 yrs of experience which should include 5+ years in software engineering, including 2 or more years managing engineering teams.
* Hands on experience with test infrastructure, lab environments, and CI/CD pipelines, including debugging across physical and virtualized systems.
* A track record in release engineering and platform reliability, with experience improving release confidence across distributed systems.
* Experience operating services on AWS, including container orchestration and managed database administration.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP and port mirroring, and of security protocols relevant to network security appliances.
* Experience managing or partnering closely with QA and DevOps functions, and comfort working alongside solution engineers and solution architects.
* Strong written communication skills, with experience producing runbooks, postmortems, and release notes that on-call engineers depend on.

**Our Values**  
  
Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that, by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk, we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.

title: AI Expert (m/f/d)
description:
**SKIDATA** is a global leader in access solutions for mobility, parking, mountain destinations, airports, shopping centres, stadiums, and attractions, combining long-term reliability with cutting-edge innovation through the hybrid integration of hardware and software across IoT, cloud, and mobility technologies. As part of our ongoing digital transformation, we are investing boldly in AI-driven engineering and intelligent automation, and we’re now looking for a passionate, hands-on **Software Expert – Lead AI Developer** in Bangalore, India, to lead the practical adoption of AI across our software development lifecycle and help shape how we build the next generation of intelligent access systems.

  

#### **What You’ll Do**

  

* **Drive Practical AI Adoption:** Bring AI to life across the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements, architecture, and coding to code review, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and maintenance.
* **Partner with Development Teams:** Work side by side with engineers and architects to uncover real day-to-day engineering challenges and co-create pilot AI-enabled solutions that make a tangible difference.
* **Lead by Example:** Use AI extensively in your own daily engineering work and demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity and quality.
* **Mentor and Inspire:** Act as an AI technical leader and mentor for software engineering teams across locations, through hands-on workshops, coaching sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities.
* **Turn Experiments into Standards:** Establish practical guidelines and repeatable workflows for responsible AI-assisted development, and integrate them into existing processes together with architects, technical managers, and engineering leaders.
* **Explore What’s Next:** Evaluate emerging AI development tools, models, frameworks, and agentic approaches, including locally hosted and open-source LLMs, with a clear view of their cost, performance, and operational trade-offs.
* **Champion an AI-First Mindset:** Help teams embrace AI-first engineering while safeguarding quality, security, and maintainability, and bring relevant external developments into the organization where they create real value.

  

In this role, you’ll become the go-to technical point of contact for AI-assisted software development and play a key part in building a sustainable, AI-enabled engineering culture. Within your first 6–12 months, you’ll see the impact of your work in stronger internal AI capabilities, high-value use cases brought to life, and measurable gains in developer productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency. Here, your ideas are valued, your curiosity is encouraged, and you’ll have the exciting opportunity to shape the way our engineers work for years to come.

  

#### **What You Bring**

  

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with AI/Generative AI technologies, or equivalent recent, demonstrable experience applying AI extensively in real-world software engineering
* Strong hands-on expertise in modern software development, architecture, design patterns, APIs, cloud-based systems, testing, and engineering practices

* Real projects where AI measurably improved development speed, quality, automation, or engineering outcomes
* Proven ability to mentor senior and junior engineers and influence teams without formal authority
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical communication skills
* A pragmatic, hands-on mindset that balances innovation with quality, security, maintainability, and business value
* Strong curiosity, a passion for experimentation, and a drive to keep learning emerging AI technologies
* Experience with LLM ecosystems (e.g., Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI), prompt and context engineering, AI agent workflows, LLM integration, locally hosted or open-source LLMs, AI coding standards and governance, or leading AI transformation within an engineering organization is a plus

  

#### **What You Can Expect**

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (Mission Control & Ground Segment)
description:
ReOrbit is looking for a Senior Cloud Infra Engineer to own and scale our Azure cloud infrastructure from our Bangalore office.

As our Senior Cloud Infra Engineer, you will be the technical owner of ReOrbit’s cloud platform, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Bangalore as part of our two-hub operating model. You will take over work currently delivered by an external DevOps and infrastructure consultant, with structured knowledge transfer in your first months.

You will be responsible for the architecture, automation, security and reliability of our cloud environment. As the role matures, you will grow into owning the cloud infrastructure, automation and reliability engineering for our Mission Control and Ground Segment.

It’s an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer

**Responsibilities**

* Own Azure platform architecture, provisioning and governance across ReOrbit’s cloud environment.
* Manage network infrastructure design, security groups, VPNs and connectivity.
* Own infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / ARM) for repeatable, auditable deployments.
* Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Drive infrastructure automation, including provisioning, configuration management and self-healing systems.
* Implement and own monitoring, alerting and observability tooling across cloud infrastructure.
* Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning, and lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Implement security controls across cloud infrastructure in partnership with the Head of Security.
* Document architecture, runbooks and procedures, lead knowledge transfer from the current external DevOps consultant, and coordinate with vendors.
* Grow into ownership of Mission Control and Ground Segment cloud infrastructure, automation and reliability engineering as the role matures.

**Skills and Requirements**

* 8–10 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud or Infrastructure engineering roles.
* Deep hands-on Microsoft Azure experience (compute, networking, storage, IAM).
* CI/CD pipeline design and infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform / ARM / Bicep).
* Strong networking and security fundamentals (VPNs, segmentation, access control).
* Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus or equivalent).
* Experience owning production infrastructure reliability and incident response.
* Comfortable working toward mission-critical, high-availability system ownership.
* Fluent English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in aerospace, satellite or other mission-critical operational environments.
* Kubernetes or other container orchestration experience.
* Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-500 or equivalent).
* Experience transitioning work from external consultants or vendors into an internal team.
* Scripting ability (Python, PowerShell or Bash) for automation.
* Exposure to ground segment, SCADA or other real-time operational systems.
* Experience scaling infrastructure ownership from start-up to enterprise.

**Working mode**

* Location: Bangalore, India, working from the office with one work-from-home day per week.
* On-call support may be required outside working hours. Please make sure you are comfortable with this before applying.

**What does ReOrbit do?**

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.

ReOrbit’s top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiary in Bariloche, Argentina.

**Working at ReOrbit**

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We’re all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength.

We offer

* Challenging but rewarding environment – you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard.
* Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space .
* Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor.
* We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking – runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion.
* We support relocation and integration into Finnish society, find some experiences about relocation here

Please, submit your application as soon as possible - we are excited to hear from you and can’t wait to discover your unique skills and experiences.

*For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.*

Our team brings together Pega engineers, technical specialists and experienced leaders. We partner closely with ASB (Auckland Savings Bank, NZ) to design and deliver secure, scalable enterprise solutions that support key business outcomes.

You will shape reusable, scalable and secure solutions using modern engineering practices, promote clean code, automation and performance optimisation, and mentor engineers to uplift squad capability.

**Pega Solution Architecture:** Own end-to-end Pega solution architecture, including application and class structure, case hierarchy, data models, ruleset strategy, reusable components and enterprise integration patterns.

**Data Architecture:** Establish sound Pega data architecture covering system-of-record boundaries, data objects, data pages, caching, persistence and data access patterns.

**Performance & Scalability:** Drive architecture for performance, scalability, availability, security and recoverability. Use Pega diagnostic and monitoring capabilities to identify bottlenecks and guide remediation.

**Pega Cloud & Constellation:**

* Working experience with Pega Cloud or a strong understanding of cloud architecture.

**Integration & Data Architecture:**

* Strong Pega integration experience using REST and API-based patterns, authentication, synchronous and asynchronous processing and background processing.

**Security & Performance:**

* Strong understanding of Pega security architecture, including authentication, SSO, OAuth/OIDC, access groups, roles, privileges and access controls.
* Experience architecting for performance, scalability, high availability, resiliency, recoverability and observability.

Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer Science/Information Technology.

• Technology Governance
