This role is responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and CPQ, along with integration touchpoints across our broader enterprise systems, including our ERP platform.
  
**This is not a design-only role:** he is also expected to personally implement enhancements and serve as the top-tier escalation point when issues arise, rolling up their sleeves to resolve urgent production, integration, and CPQ problems directly. The ideal candidate has deep, hands-on architecture experience across the full Salesforce platform lifecycle -- from data model and security design through integration architecture, hands-on build, and release governance -- and can operate independently as the primary technical authority for Salesforce within the organization. This person will partner closely with the business-side Salesforce admin team, the broader IT organization, and the Natus Neuro IT team (TSA partner) on shared systems.
  
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Salesforce Platform Architecture & Strategy (25%)
  

* Own the overall Salesforce architecture strategy, including org structure, data model, sharing/security model, and platform scalability roadmap
* Translate business requirements from Sales, Service, and Operations stakeholders into scalable, well-governed technical designs
* Define and enforce architectural standards, design patterns, and best practices across Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative automation (Flow)
* Evaluate new Salesforce releases, features, and AppExchange products; recommend adoption where it advances the roadmap
* Lead architectural review of major enhancements, custom development, and third-party package implementations
* Maintain a multi-year Salesforce technical roadmap aligned with business strategy

Integration Architecture (20%)
  

* Design and govern integration architecture between Salesforce and enterprise systems, including ERP (Oracle EBS or similar), Microsoft 365, and other business systems
* Architect and oversee middleware/integration platform usage (MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS) for real-time and batch integrations
* Define API strategy, data synchronization patterns, and error-handling/monitoring standards across integrations
* Partner with ERP, data, and infrastructure teams to ensure integration reliability and data integrity across systems
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex, cross-system integration issues

Enhancement Implementation & Hands-On Development (15%)
  

* Personally build and deploy approved enhancements -- including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow automation, and configuration -- rather than handing designs off exclusively to others
* Own delivery of enhancement projects end-to-end: requirements, build, testing, and release, balancing scope, quality, and timeline
* Partner with the business-side Salesforce admin team to convert approved designs into working, tested solutions in the org
* Write and maintain clean, well-documented, testable code and configuration that other admins/developers can support

CPQ & Quote-to-Cash Architecture (10%)
  

* Architect and maintain Salesforce CPQ configuration, including product catalog, pricing rules, approval workflows, and quote templates
* Design quote-to-cash process flows in partnership with Sales Operations and Finance
* Ensure CPQ architecture scales with evolving product lines, pricing models, and channel strategies
* Troubleshoot CPQ configuration issues and guide the business admin team on best practices

Data Architecture, Security & Governance (15%)
  

* Design and maintain the Salesforce data model, including object relationships, record types, and data lifecycle management
* Define and enforce security architecture: profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field-level security
* Establish data governance standards, including deduplication, data quality rules, and archiving/retention policies
* Support compliance and audit activities related to Salesforce access, data handling, and change management
* Administer and govern DevOps/release management tooling (e.g., Salesforce DX, Gearset, Copado, or similar) and sandbox strategy

Production Support & Escalations (10%)
  

* Serve as the top-tier escalation point for complex Salesforce, integration, and CPQ issues that the business admin team cannot resolve
* Roll up sleeves to directly troubleshoot and resolve urgent, business-impacting production issues rather than deferring to others
* Triage and drive resolution of production incidents, coordinating with IT and business stakeholders as needed
* Maintain and improve runbooks and troubleshooting documentation based on recurring escalations
* Be responsive and available for critical, time-sensitive support needs outside of standard change requests

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management (5%)
  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for all Salesforce architecture decisions
* Liaise with the Natus Neuro IT team (TSA partner) on shared Salesforce systems, integrations, and escalated issues
* Mentor administrators and junior developers on platform best practices
* Communicate technical roadmaps, trade-offs, and risks clearly to non-technical stakeholders and leadership

**Travel Required:** Minimal; occasional travel for planning sessions or team meetings may be requested.
  
  
**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:**  

* Willingness to personally build and deploy enhancements, not just design and hand off to others
* 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including 3+ years in an architect-level role
* Demonstrated experience architecting solutions across Sales Cloud and Revenue Cloud
* Hands-on experience architecting and supporting Salesforce CPQ (product catalog, pricing, approvals, quote-to-cash)
* Proven experience designing and governing integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems (ERP, middleware/iPaaS such as MuleSoft)
* Strong command of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce declarative tools (Flow)
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps/release management practices and tools (Salesforce DX, version control, CI/CD pipelines)
* Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, scalable technical architecture
* Comfortable serving as a top-tier escalation point for urgent, complex issues and rolling up sleeves to resolve them directly
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to present architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Self-starter mentality: able to independently own architecture decisions and production issues with minimal oversight
* Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of up to 30 days preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or actively pursuing the CTA credential
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect and/or System Architect
* Additional certifications: Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Platform Developer II
* Experience in a medical device, life sciences, or other regulated industry environment
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA as they relate to CRM data
* Experience integrating Salesforce with Oracle EBS or comparable ERP platforms
* Experience with Health Cloud or other industry-specific Salesforce clouds

Education and/or Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience. Salesforce architect-level certifications are highly valued and may substitute for formal education.
  
What We Offer
  

* Opportunity to own and shape Salesforce architecture for a growing medical device organization
* Competitive salary, commensurate with experience, with benefits package
* Exposure to enterprise integration architecture (Salesforce, ERP, MuleSoft/iPaaS) in a regulated industry.

**Compensation and Benefits:** Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws.
  
  
Join Natus Sensory today. Confidence in every Sense.
  
  
**We offer:**  

* The role will start as a work-from-home remote position but will turn into a physical presence in an office role in Bangalore.
* Minimal travelling: less than 5%
* Collaborative and international environment with different cultures.
* English company language.
* Full ownership of testing of features and functionality.

**Your impact begins here**

As Senior Security Architect II (Email & Cloud Security), you will own the architecture that protects how Novo communicates and works in the cloud. You will set the vision, standards and roadmap for email and cloud security, turning business and security needs into designs that are secure, scalable and sustainable. Your work helps the Cyber Defence Center detect threats earlier and respond faster, so colleagues across Novo can keep making progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

  

**What you’ll bring**

You combine deep technical expertise with the judgement to balance strong security with what the business needs.

* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration or a related field (BE, MSc, MBA or similar).
* 12+ years of IT experience, including security consulting, project management and service management roles.
* Strong hands-on expertise in email security, including mail flow, message headers, SMTP and email authentication standards such as SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MTA-STS.
* Experience architecting and optimising platforms such as Mimecast, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Exchange Online Protection and Microsoft Defender XDR.
* Solid knowledge of cloud security, including CSPM/CNAPP and cloud workload protection with tools such as Wiz and Prisma Cloud.
* Experience investigating email-based threats such as phishing, Business Email Compromise, spoofing and malware, using header analysis, message tracing and IoCs.
* 5–8 years of experience working with GxP requirements, validation and compliance, and in-depth knowledge of ITIL incident, problem and change management.
* A structured, self-driven way of working, with strong communication skills and comfort collaborating across cultures and time zones.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Experience with cloud migrations.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma or Agile frameworks.
* Experience configuring ServiceNow ITSM and ITOM processes.
  

**What you’ll do**

* You will be the architectural single point of contact for email and cloud security, setting direction and making decisions within your governance area. You will:
* Define and evolve the strategic vision, architecture and roadmap for cloud, SaaS and email security, in line with Novo’s enterprise security strategy.
* Set architecture principles, standards, reference architectures and guardrails, and lead design reviews, gap analyses and proofs of concept.
* Lead the architecture, policies and integrations for Mimecast, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Defender XDR, Valimail, Wiz and Prisma Cloud.
* Shape architecture and controls that strengthen monitoring, detection, threat hunting, incident response and automation, and guide investigations into complex email threats.
* Promote a security-by-design approach: when exceptions are requested, find secure, supportable alternatives rather than broad whitelisting or control bypasses.
* Own service strategy, risk management, KPIs and SLA performance, and work with vendors on deliverables, quotations, licences and contracts alongside the service owner.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

* You will join STO-XDR within the Cyber Defence Center, Novo’s dedicated cyber defence organisation. The CDC protects the company from cyber threats, detects incidents, responds quickly and hardens technologies, processes and systems so the business can operate safely. STO-XDR runs and sustains the security technology stack: managing day-to-day platform operations, upgrades and vendor relationships, ensuring logs and telemetry flow into the CDC ecosystem, and keeping platforms audit-ready and supported to agreed SLAs.
* Your closest partners will be CDC colleagues in India and Denmark, CDC management, the CISO organisation, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Workplace, Cloud Platform, Security Operations, Enterprise IT, and IT service, system and quality managers across the business. Externally, you will work with strategic suppliers including Mimecast, Microsoft, Wiz, Valimail and cloud workload protection vendors.
* You will bring different perspectives together, influence stakeholders with differing interests and speak up when decisions stall, so security is built in from the start.
  

**What you can expect here**

* You will be trusted to work independently, own architectural decisions and set direction with significant impact across a wide, international and cross-functional area. Your expertise will be heard in technical forums and architecture discussions, and you will have room to evaluate emerging technologies and keep improving how Novo protects its email and cloud landscape.
* You will grow through global collaboration, close work with leading security vendors and the chance to mentor colleagues in your field. The work moves at pace, with clear expectations and a team that values curiosity, honest feedback and quality.
  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape the architecture that keeps Novo secure, apply for the Senior Security Architect II (Email & Cloud Security) role by 27 Oct 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: IH Salesforce Production Support - Cigna Healthcare
description:
Technical Support Analyst
  
  
Position Information
  
  

* Job Title: Technical Support Analyst
* Function: Production Support / Salesforce Support
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Location: Bangalore
* Reports To: Cloud Support Manager

Role Purpose
  
  
The Technical Support Analyst is a hands-on member of the Production Support team, responsible for supporting and maintaining Salesforce applications used across Cigna International Health.
  
  
The primary focus of the role is day-to-day Salesforce administration across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, including user lifecycle management, access and permissions, declarative configuration, data maintenance, reporting, and operational support. The role also investigates and manages application incidents through ServiceNow, working with business users, technical teams, and senior support colleagues to restore service, meet agreed service levels, and provide a high standard of customer support.
  
The successful candidate will work with appropriate autonomy, prioritize their workload, and deliver accurate, controlled, and well-documented outcomes. They will escalate work requiring development, architecture decisions, elevated privileges, or higher-risk production changes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Salesforce Administration and User Access
  
  

* Create, update, activate, freeze, and deactivate Salesforce users in accordance with approved access requests and user lifecycle procedures.
* Maintain user access through profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, public groups, and other approved access mechanisms.
* Investigate and resolve common login, visibility, permission, object-access, field-access, and record-access issues.
* Maintain access hygiene by reviewing assignments, identifying inappropriate or obsolete access, and supporting periodic access reviews.
* Apply least-privilege and segregation-of-duties principles, escalating privileged, unusual, or high-risk access requests to the appropriate security, identity-management, or senior Salesforce resource.
* Maintain clear evidence of approvals and completed access changes where required for audit or control purposes.

Declarative Configuration and Platform Maintenance
  
  

* Configure and maintain Salesforce using approved declarative, “clicks-not-code” capabilities.
* Support routine changes to standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, queues, assignment rules, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and other administrative configurations.
* Assist with basic Salesforce Flow configuration and troubleshooting where the requirement is within the role’s approved administrative scope.
* Perform configuration and operational support across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.
* Validate changes in an appropriate lower environment before production implementation, following established testing, approval, deployment, and post-implementation validation procedures.
* Monitor the impact of routine Salesforce releases and support low-risk readiness or validation activities.
* Escalate requirements involving Apex, Lightning Web Components, complex integrations, architecture changes, or development-intensive solutions.

Data Maintenance and Reporting
  
  

* Maintain Salesforce data accurately and securely, including approved record creation, updates, corrections, ownership changes, and controlled bulk activities.
* Support data imports, exports, and mass updates using authorized tools and documented procedures.
* Complete appropriate validation and reconciliation before and after data changes.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, obsolete, or inconsistent information and work with data owners to improve data quality.
* Create and maintain standard reports and dashboards to support operational and business requirements.
* Protect sensitive information and avoid unapproved data deletion, extraction, or other high-risk data activity.
* Maintain traceable records of approvals, test results, data files, outcomes, and rollback information where required.

Incident and Application Support
  
  

* Monitor and manage incidents and support requests assigned through ServiceNow.
* Review ticket information, confirm the reported symptoms and business impact, and gather any additional information required to investigate the issue.
* Validate that the correct application or configuration item is recorded and ensure the incident is assigned to the appropriate support group.
* Investigate common Salesforce and supported application issues, including user access, permissions, configuration, data, workflow, and functional errors.
* Reproduce issues where appropriate, review available documentation and known issues, and identify a resolution, workaround, or appropriate escalation path.
* Maintain accurate ticket states and remain aware of applicable responses and resolution of SLAs.
* Record meaningful internal investigation details, actions taken, dependencies, and escalation of information in work notes.
* Provide clear and timely customer updates through the appropriate customer-visible ServiceNow fields.
* Reassign incidents promptly when another team is required, documenting the reason for reassignment.
* Complete accurate resolution information and clear resolution notes before resolving a ticket.
* Escalate major, high-impact, recurring, security-related, or technically complex incidents in accordance with established support procedures.

Documentation, Automation, and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Create and maintain clear operational documentation, runbooks, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Identify repetitive, manual, or error-prone activities that may be suitable for controlled automation.
* Contribute to the design, testing, documentation, and ongoing monitoring of low-risk automation solutions.
* Recommend improvements that increase support efficiency, data quality, customer experience, control effectiveness, or service reliability.

Collaboration and Customer Service
  
  

* Work effectively with geographically distributed colleagues across business, production support, identity and access management, security, product, engineering, and development teams.
* Translate technical issues into clear, practical information for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Manage assigned work with appropriate autonomy, balancing priorities, risk, business impact, and SLA commitments.
* Provide accurate, professional, and customer-focused communication throughout requests and incidents.
* Seek guidance when requirements are unclear and escalate promptly when an issue exceeds the role’s authority or technical scope.

Required Skills and Experience
  
  

* Minimum of three years of professional experience working as a Salesforce Administrator.
* Practical administration experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Experience Cloud
* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce user provisioning, deactivation, access management, profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, and public groups.
* Experience configuring standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, validation rules, assignment rules, reports, and dashboards.
* Experience with declarative Salesforce administration and basic Flow configuration or troubleshooting.
* Experience performing controlled data imports, exports, corrections, bulk updates, and data-quality activities.
* Demonstrated experience supporting production applications and investigating user, access, configuration, data, and functional issues.
* Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation, ticket records, change evidence, and audit trails.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to security, data protection, operational risk, and change control.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to prioritize assigned work, work independently within defined procedures, and recognize when escalation is required.

Preferred or Desirable Skills
  
  

* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, including incident handling, work notes, customer updates, resolution information, and SLA awareness.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.
* Experience supporting Salesforce in a health insurance, healthcare or other regulated environment.
* Experience with access reviews, audit evidence, segregation-of-duties controls, or identity and access management processes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, Jira, Confluence, knowledge management, release-readiness activities, user acceptance testing, and smoke testing.
* Exposure to application-monitoring or log-analysis tools such as Dynatrace or Splunk.
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate recurring administrative or support activities.

Behaviors and Competencies
  
  

* Customer focused: Provides responsive, accurate, and professional support.
* Team player: Collaborates openly across geographic, business, and technical boundaries.
* Problem solver: Investigates methodically and uses evidence to reach sound conclusions.
* Autonomous: Takes ownership of assigned work while escalating appropriately.
* Process minded: Follows documented controls and maintains complete, traceable records.
* Security and risk aware: Protects access, data, system stability, and audit integrity.
* Curious and adaptable: Learns unfamiliar applications and business processes confidently.
* Continuous-improvement driven: Challenges inefficient manual processes and proposes safe, practical improvements.
* Clear communicator: Explains technical matters effectively to different audiences.
* Dependable: Manages priorities and delivers work to agreed time and quality expectations.

Scope of the Role
  
  
This is primarily a Salesforce administration and production-support position, not a Salesforce developer or solution-architect role. The analyst is expected to complete routine declarative configuration and operational support independently within approved procedures. Custom development, complex integration work, architecture decisions, privileged actions, and high-risk production changes must be referred to the appropriate senior administrator, engineering, architecture, security, or development team.
  
Measures of Success
  
  
**Success in the position will be demonstrated through:**  

* Timely and accurate completion of user lifecycle and access requests.
* Achievement of applicable incident and request SLAs.
* High-quality investigation notes, customer communications, and resolution records.
* Secure, accurate, and controlled Salesforce configuration and data maintenance.
* Complete change, approval, testing, and audit evidence.
* Effective escalation of work outside administrative scope.
* Current, usable operational documentation and knowledge articles.
* Measurable contribution to automation, process improvement, and reduced recurring support efforts.

About The Cigna Group
  
  
Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

The position includes accountability for code review and the team’s development and testing activities, as well as participation in proof of concepts and technical evaluations of new technologies. The Sr. Manager is expected to foster a collaborative environment, ensuring the team meets business needs and delivers robust solutions.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Essential Functions:

People Leadership & Talent Development:

* Hire, retain, and develop a diverse, high-performing team of software engineers across the Bangalore hub.
* Own performance management, career growth, and promotion pipelines; deliver concrete coaching and mentoring to grow engineers into senior/staff roles.
* Build a healthy, inclusive team culture with strong engagement and retention signals.

Delivery & Execution Management:

* Own end-to-end delivery for a product area — planning, prioritization, risk management, and predictable execution against roadmap commitments.
* Drive operational excellence: incident ownership, on-call health, code quality, and reduction of technical debt.
* Manage multiple competing initiatives and timelines, balancing scope, speed, and quality.
* Establish and track delivery metrics (on-time delivery, uptime, throughput, defect rates) and report progress to stakeholders.

Technical Credibility & Hands-On Engagement:

* Stay close enough to the technology to review code and designs, unblock engineers, and make sound technical calls — capable of going hands-on when needed.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews; provide informed technical judgment on trade-offs.
* Guide troubleshooting, defect triage, and root-cause analysis for critical issues.

GenAI/LLM Leadership:

* Champion the adoption of GenAI and modern engineering tooling within the team, driving practical, production use cases.
* Stay technically literate in GenAI/LLM concepts and evaluate opportunities to apply them to the product area.
* Partner with engineers building GenAI-enabled features; support experimentation while ensuring production rigor.

System Design & Architecture Judgment:

* Guide the team's architecture and technical direction for the product area, ensuring scalability, security, and resilience.
* Evaluate build-vs-buy and technology choices; set standards for APIs, microservices, and integration patterns (HTTP, REST, JSON, XML).
* Partner with architects and other engineering leaders to align designs with platform-wide standards.

Stakeholder & Organizational Influence:

* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, QA, DevOps, and global engineering teams to deliver complete solutions.
* Partner with business stakeholders on requirements, workflow design, and process re-engineering.
* Represent the team in cross-org planning and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to leadership.
* Collaborate across global, distributed teams and time zones to ensure alignment and consistent delivery standards.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

* 12 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 10 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree, or 7 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* Proven experience leading and growing engineering teams — hiring, coaching, performance management, and driving retention.
* Track record of delivering a product area predictably, with metrics for on-time delivery, quality, and operational health.
* Hands-on coding experience in one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#, Node.js), with the depth to review code and engage in technical discussions.
* Expertise with container and cloud technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, or Splunk).
* Experience championing or driving adoption of GenAI/LLM technologies within an engineering team.
* Experience building and guiding teams that build microservices using HTTP, REST, JSON, and XML.
* Experience guiding system design and architecture decisions for a product or platform area.
* Experience managing incidents, production support, and operational excellence practices.
* Experience partnering with product, QA, DevOps, and Agile/Scrum teams in a distributed, global engineering organization.
* Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical and business trade-offs to diverse stakeholders.
* Payment industry experience is highly desirable.

The Skills You Bring:

* Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technology, and enjoys leading teams on challenging, global-scale projects.
* People-First Leadership: A genuine investment in developing engineers, with a track record of promotions, mentoring, and healthy team retention.

title: Salesforce Net Zero
description:
# Salesforce Net Zero

\*\*JP ID:\*\* DLTJP00061702

\*\*Skill:\*\* Salesforce Net Zero

\*\*Experience:\*\* 5+ years

\*\*Location:\*\* Hyderabad / Bangalore

\*\*No. of Positions:\*\* 1

\*\*Budget:\*\* As per market standards

## Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce professional to lead the functional and technical delivery of Salesforce solutions supporting Net Zero and sustainability initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring extensive Salesforce implementation experience, strong hands-on development capabilities, and the ability to translate complex sustainability requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.

This role will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, developers, and delivery teams to design and implement innovative Salesforce capabilities that support sustainability, ESG, carbon management, and Net Zero objectives.

## Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of Salesforce solutions for Net Zero and sustainability programs.

- Engage with business stakeholders to understand objectives, gather requirements, and define practical solution approaches.

- Translate business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.

- Design, develop, configure, and implement Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, Visualforce, SOQL, and SOSL.

- Configure and customize Salesforce objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, automation, reports, dashboards, and security controls.

- Design and implement integrations with external systems using APIs, middleware platforms, and event-driven integration patterns.

- Support data migration, data quality management, data modeling, reporting, and dashboard development.

- Ensure solutions align with Salesforce best practices, performance standards, security requirements, and enterprise governance.

- Participate in solution reviews, code reviews, testing, deployment, release management, and production support.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

- Mentor junior team members and provide technical guidance throughout the delivery lifecycle.

- Contribute to Agile ceremonies, planning activities, estimation, and delivery tracking.

## Required Qualifications and Skills

- 10+ years of experience delivering Salesforce solutions in enterprise environments.

- Experience supporting sustainability, ESG, carbon accounting, or Net Zero programs.

- Knowledge of Salesforce Net Zero Cloud.

- Strong functional knowledge of Salesforce implementations and business analysis.

- Hands-on experience with:

- Apex

- Lightning Web Components

- SOQL and SOSL

- Salesforce Flows

- Salesforce integrations and APIs

- Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or custom Salesforce platform development.

- Strong understanding of Salesforce data models, security architecture, sharing rules, permission sets, and governor limits.

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and delivery teams.

- Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

- Proven ability to work across complex, large-scale enterprise programs.

- Experience with MuleSoft or other integration and middleware platforms.

- Salesforce certifications, such as:

- Platform Developer I or II

- Salesforce Administrator

- Platform App Builder

- Architect-level certifications

- Experience with DevOps tools, source control, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Experience supporting enterprise data migration and data governance initiatives.

## Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

- Salesforce certifications.

## Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate combines deep Salesforce technical expertise with strong functional and consulting capabilities. They can move comfortably between business discussions, solution architecture, hands-on development, and delivery leadership, while maintaining a focus on quality, scalability, security, and business value.

## How You’ll Grow

At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal in creating a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills, and as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way.

No two people learn in exactly the same way. Therefore, we provide a range of resources, including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning center in the Hyderabad office, is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development.

## Deloitte’s Culture

Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware.

We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives.

## Corporate Citizenship

Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities.

We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities.

Pay: Up to ₹1,700,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Role Overview:**

The Data Architect will be responsible for defining, designing, and governing the data architecture for Billing end to end process, that enables scalable, secure, and business-aligned data platforms! This role requires deep expertise in data modeling, cloud data warehousing, integration patterns, governance frameworks, and modern analytics architectures to support reporting, regulatory compliance, and advanced analytics.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Enterprise Data Architecture**

Define and maintain the data architecture roadmap aligned with business and technology strategies.

Design scalable and reusable data architectures, including operational, analytical, and reporting data layers.

Establish enterprise data models, conceptual, logical, and physical data models, ensuring consistency across domains.

Develop and maintain dimensional models, star schemas, and canonical data models to support reporting and analytics requirements.

Drive architecture standards, design patterns, and best practices for data platforms and integrations.

  

**Data Acquisition & Integration**

Design and govern data ingestion, integration, and transformation frameworks using native AWS tools like Glue, Air Flow and Snowflake , Data Bricks as Data Store

Architect data pipelines and integration patterns for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources.

Ensure end-to-end data lineage, reconciliation, and traceability across all billing process data flows.

Define standards for data quality, validation, and data synchronization across platforms.

Optimize data movement and transformation processes for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  

**Cloud Data Platform & Warehousing**

Architect enterprise data solutions leveraging Snowflake and cloud platforms including AWS.

Define data storage, compute, security, and data lifecycle management strategies.

Design modern data warehouse, data lake, and lakehouse architectures to support enterprise-wide reporting and analytics.

Establish standards for data partitioning, clustering, performance optimization, and workload management.

Collaborate with infrastructure and engineering teams to ensure resilient and scalable data environments.

  

**Reporting & Analytics Enablement**

Partner with reporting and analytics teams to ensure data architectures support business intelligence and self-service analytics.

Define and maintain certified data products and semantic layers for reporting tools such as Power BI.

Ensure data models are optimized for analytical consumption and regulatory reporting requirements.

Enable consistent metrics, KPIs, and master data definitions across business functions.

  

**Governance, Metadata & Security**

Lead implementation of enterprise data governance frameworks, standards, and policies.

Establish and manage metadata management, business glossaries, and data catalog capabilities.

Define data security architecture, including role-based access controls, encryption, masking, and regulatory compliance requirements.

Ensure adherence to audit, risk, privacy, and regulatory standards.

Promote data stewardship and ownership across business and technology teams.

  

**Data Operations & Orchestration**

Define standards for workflow orchestration and scheduling using Control-M or equivalent enterprise scheduling tools.

Design monitoring frameworks for data quality, pipeline reliability, and operational excellence.

Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity considerations are embedded into data architecture designs.

  

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* Extensive experience in Data Architecture, Data Warehousing, and Enterprise Data Modeling.

* Strong expertise in Snowflake architecture, administration, and performance optimization.

* Experience with ETL/ELT platforms such as AWS Glue, Airflow, Ab Initio, Matillion, DataStage, or comparable technologies.

* Deep understanding of dimensional modeling, star schema, data vault, and enterprise data modeling techniques.

* Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure data services.

* Strong knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality frameworks.

* Experience defining architecture standards, integration patterns, and technology roadmaps.

* Understanding of security, compliance, and risk management principles for enterprise data environments.

* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience within Financial Services, Risk Management, Regulatory Reporting, or Compliance domains.

* Familiarity with enterprise data governance and cataloging platforms such as Collibra, Alation, or Microsoft Purview.

* Experience implementing modern data architectures including Data Lake, Lakehouse, and Data Mesh concepts.

* Knowledge of AI/ML data platform requirements and analytics ecosystems.

* Professional certifications in Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or Enterprise Architecture frameworks.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.

  

**Benefits:**

* Equal opportunity employer with hybrid working arrangements.

* Annual Leave and Parental Leave benefits.

* Upskilling opportunities through role-relevant training and certifications.

* Dedicated Employee Assistance and Wellbeing Programs.

* Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale data transformation and analytics initiatives.

* Collaborative environment focused on innovation, growth, and continuous learning.

**High-impact projects** : We work on a variety of pioneering AI products and leverage extensive datasets to solve complex, high-value challenges.

**Competitive benefits** : You will enjoy a strong compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing investment in career growth and skill development.

We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible, and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take a hybrid approach to the workplace; this role is considered ‘Blended’, which requires attending the office at least three day per week while some teams and colleagues choose to collaborate in the office more frequently.

title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
* Job ID: 916314
* 5 - 6 Years
* 2 Openings
* Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata

  

### **Role description**

Grant Thornton INDUS is the in-house offshore center for Grant Thornton US- a member firm of Grant Thornton International, with offices in Bangalore and Kolkata. Our team of over 2,400 professionals specializes in Tax, Audit, Advisory, Operations, and Enabling functions, delivering exceptional client service, and driving excellence across all domains. We are proud to have been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the last two consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to building a high-trust, high-performance culture. At Grant Thornton INDUS, our people-centric culture is rooted in empowering individuals, bold leadership, and a commitment to providing distinctive client experiences. We foster a transparent, competitive, and performance-driven environment where professionals are given opportunities to contribute to meaningful and impactful initiatives. Our young and dynamic workforce not only excels in delivering business outcomes but also inspires and gives back to the community through generous and impactful service initiatives.

**Why Join Grant Thornton INDUS?**

* **Empowered Environment:** We encourage autonomy and bold decision-making at all levels, shaping our future together.
* **Significant Contributions:** We provide ample opportunities to deliver transformational results and exceptional client service, driving innovation and growth.
* **Culture of Excellence:** We promote transparency, competitiveness, and a relentless drive to excel.
* **Learning Opportunities:** We offer diverse, multi-platform learning opportunities for dynamic growth.
* **Vibrant Culture:** Our open culture fosters diversity, acceptance, engagement, and enjoyment for all.
* **Community Impact:** We support initiatives that enable employees to make meaningful contributions to society and make a wider difference.

**Summary**

Grant Thornton GTech’s Data & Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization’s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption.

* Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns.

* Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation).

* Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption.

* Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders.

* Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs.

* Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers.

* Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets.

* Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

* Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation.

* Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members.

**Skills**

* Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing.

* Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics.

* Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct & optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis & troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams & Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets.

* Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers.

* Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance).

* Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement).

* Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

* Strong understanding of data lineage, metadata traceability, and impact analysis.

* Experience applying governance-by-design and data observability (data quality tests, lineage, and certified datasets).

* Effective communication skills with ability to work directly with business stakeholders.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

* 5+ years of analytics engineering, BI/data warehouse development, or related data experience in enterprise data environments.

* Preferred: Experience in professional services, accounting industry, or client service/consultative technology roles.

* Experience with ETL/ELT tools (Informatica, dbt).

* Experience with BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Excel).

* Experience with data modeling methodologies (Dimensional modeling, Data Marts, Data Warehousing, Star/Snowflake schema).

* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

* Agile/Scrum delivery exposure.

**Grant Thornton INDUS (Full-Time Employee) Benefits:**

* **Insurance:** Health, Accidental, and Term Life Insurance for employees (and dependents as applicable).
* **Wellness:** Employee Assistance Program, Corporate Health Plans, Gym (Bangalore), Wellness Webinars, Health months.
* **Work-Life Balance:** Hybrid work model, flexible work options for returning mothers.
* **Parental Support:** Maternity/Paternity leave, daycare facilities, flexible work arrangements.
* **Mobility:** Secondment opportunities, relocation benefits, internal job postings.
* **Retirement:** Provident Fund, Gratuity, Leave Encashment, National Pension Scheme.
* **Additional Benefits:** Women’s security (night transport), home office setup allowance, certification reimbursements, meal cards, appreciation holidays, service awards.
* **Learning:** Multi-channelIn-house learning platform, LinkedIn Learning, certification programs.

  

**About Grant Thornton INDUS**

title: Azure Architect
description:
**Experience:** 10 – 12 Years

**Required Skills**

Microsoft Fabric Architecture, One Lake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Direct Lake Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics Medallion Architecture and Data Governance Azure Cloud Architecture, Landing Zones and Networking Security: Entra ID, RBAC, Purview, Key Vault DevSecOps, CI/CD, Terraform/Bicep Enterprise Data Migration and Modernization Architecture Leadership, Pre-Sales and Stakeholder Mana

**Role summary**

The Azure Architect is the design authority for enterprise data and analytics platforms built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure. You will define target-state architecture, landing zone and security guardrails, and the DevSecOps operating model that lets delivery teams ship Fabric workloads safely and repeatably. You will lead client-facing architecture, pre-sales solutioning and governance boards, and mentor senior engineers and specialists.

**Key responsibilities**

**Architecture and design authority**

* Define end-to-end target architecture for Microsoft Fabric: OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks/Spark, Real-Time Intelligence (Eventstream, Eventhouse/KQL), and Power BI semantic models using Direct Lake.
* Design medallion (bronze/silver/gold) and data-mesh patterns using Fabric domains, workspaces, OneLake shortcuts (ADLS Gen2, S3, GCS, Dataverse) and Mirroring (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Snowflake, Databricks catalogs).
* Own capacity strategy: F-SKU sizing, capacity separation (dev/test/prod, workload isolation), autoscale, smoothing and throttling behaviour, Capacity Metrics app monitoring and chargeback.
* Produce architecture decision records (ADRs), HLD/LLD, reference architectures and non-functional requirements (availability, RPO/RTO, performance, cost).
* Lead migration architecture from Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, SQL Server/SSIS, Power BI Premium (P-SKU) and on-premises warehouses to Fabric.
* Design Azure landing zones aligned to the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well-Architected Framework: management group hierarchy, subscription vending, hub-spoke or Virtual WAN networking, Azure Firewall, Private DNS.
* Define network isolation for Fabric: Private Links (tenant and workspace level), Managed Private Endpoints, managed virtual networks, trusted workspace access, on-premises and VNet data gateways.
* Architect supporting services: ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Functions, AKS/Container Apps, Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry integration with Fabric data agents and Copilot.
* Define identity model with Microsoft Entra ID: security groups, workspace roles, item permissions, OneLake security (role-based data access), row/column/object-level security, service principals and workspace identities, PIM and Conditional Access.
* Integrate Microsoft Purview: data map and scanning, Unified Catalog, sensitivity labels and label inheritance in Fabric, DLP policies, lineage and audit.
* Set encryption and key management standards: customer-managed keys, Azure Key Vault, managed identities, secret rotation.
* Map controls to regulatory frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, DPDP Act, RBI/SEBI or industry equivalents) and lead security architecture reviews and threat modelling (STRIDE).
* Own Fabric tenant settings governance and admin-portal policy baseline.
* Define the secure SDLC for data workloads: branching strategy, Fabric Git integration (Azure DevOps Repos / GitHub), deployment pipelines (dev → test → prod), deployment rules and parameterisation.
* Standardise Infrastructure as Code with Terraform (azurerm, azapi and the Microsoft Fabric provider) and/or Bicep; define module registries, state management and policy-as-code (Azure Policy, OPA/Conftest, Sentinel).
* Define CI/CD reference pipelines on Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions using the Fabric REST APIs and the fabric-cicd Python library, with OIDC / workload identity federation (no long-lived secrets).
* Embed security gates: SAST (CodeQL, SonarQube), secret scanning (GitHub Advanced Security, Gitleaks), IaC scanning (Checkov, tfsec/Trivy), dependency/SCA scanning, container image scanning and SBOM generation.
* Define posture management with Microsoft Defender for Cloud (CSPM, DevOps security connectors), Microsoft Sentinel alerting and audit-log streaming.

**Azure platform and landing zone**

**Security, governance and compliance**

**DevSecOps and platform engineering**

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

Senior Manager - AI & IT

This is a hands-on technical role. You will code, design, and implement IAM solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. You will partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.

* Strong experience in Agentic AI IAM architecture, identity governance, secrets management, security engineering, and enterprise IAM program delivery.

title: Guidewire Architect
description:

Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to implement, modernize, and optimize their core platforms, with a strong focus on cloud adoption and AI-enabled delivery. We work as one global team, combining deep product expertise, implementation excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement to help customers realize value faster. Our environment is collaborative, customer-obsessed, and innovation-driven, centered on Guidewire InsuranceSuite and the Guidewire Cloud Platform.
  
  
As a Guidewire Architect focused on PolicyCenter, you will define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for complex, often greenfield implementations across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, lead critical design decisions, and ensure solutions meet demanding performance, scalability, and security needs.
  
  
This role is ideal for a hands-on expert who enjoys solving complex business problems, shaping implementation strategy, and accelerating our customers’ path to value while contributing to Professional Services’ mission to cut implementation effort and time through AI and automation.

**Job Description**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Define and own the technical architecture, design standards, and implementation roadmap for Guidewire PolicyCenter across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid deployments, aligning with customer enterprise architectures and Guidewire best practices.
* Lead end-to-end PolicyCenter configuration and customization, including Gosu development, PCF/UI design, data model extensions, underwriting rules, workflows, and plugins, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to business needs.
* Architect and oversee complex integrations between PolicyCenter and enterprise systems (billing, CRM, data warehouses, external partners, document management, and third-party services) using APIs, web services, and messaging patterns.
* Provide day-to-day technical leadership for cross-functional delivery teams, performing architecture and code reviews, mentoring senior developers and integrators, and driving engineering excellence and high test coverage (including GUnit).
* Collaborate closely with business analysts and customer stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable architectures and non-functional designs covering performance, availability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Champion Professional Services priorities by leveraging AI and automation to reduce implementation effort and time, support cloud migration and adoption, and help industrialize repeatable, high-quality delivery patterns across projects.
* Contribute to organizational assets such as accelerators, reference architectures, and technical white papers, and lead knowledge-sharing to uplift Guidewire and partner teams globally.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

**Required**

* 10–18 years of hands-on experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter, including at least two greenfield PolicyCenter implementations.
* Guidewire Certified ACE for PolicyCenter Configuration, with deep knowledge of PolicyCenter UI, data model, Studio, and out-of-the-box features and accelerators.
* Strong experience with Gosu, PCF, entities, typelists, rules, workflows, plugins, and configuration for new personal and commercial lines of business.
* Proven track record architecting and delivering complex integrations using RESTful APIs, web services, messaging, and related technologies (e.g., Apache Camel, Bitbucket, IntelliJ).
* Solid understanding of object-oriented design principles, performance optimization, security best practices, and non-functional requirements design for mission-critical systems.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and to work in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Flexibility to collaborate across time zones and shifts when needed to support customers and global teams.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
  

  

**Preferred**

* Experience with Guidewire Cloud (PolicyCenter on Guidewire Cloud Platform), including cloud-native patterns, observability, and CI/CD practices.
* Background leading architecture on multiple PolicyCenter cloud or upgrade programs, especially those leveraging AI-enabled tools or automation to reduce implementation effort.
* Familiarity with other Guidewire products (ClaimCenter, BillingCenter, Analytics, or Data Platform) and with modern microservices or event-driven architectures.
* BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

**Your Impact**
---------------

We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will take architectural ownership of one or more complex PolicyCenter implementations, aligning solution designs with customer business objectives while embedding Professional Services’ priorities around AI-enabled, faster, and more predictable delivery.

  
  

You will define technical roadmaps, guide teams through critical design and integration decisions, and put in place patterns and assets that measurably reduce implementation effort and time for future projects. As your influence grows, you will help customers fully leverage Guidewire’s cloud and AI platform, directly supporting our wider mission to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business and advancing Guidewire’s ambition to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions globally.

  
  

**What’s in it for you**
  
The people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as:
  
Flexible work environment.
  
Health and wellness benefits.
  
Paid time off programs including volunteer time off.
  
Market‑competitive pay and incentive programs.
  
Continual development and internal career growth opportunities.
  
  
All roles at Guidewire include an in‑person interview experience, and we provide an in‑person orientation for all new hires to help you build relationships and understand how your work contributes to our customers and mission.

Interested in this position?

  

**About Guidewire**

  
  

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

  
  

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

  
  

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.

description:

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1746236

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Senior Security Consultant**

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

**EY Technology** supports our technology needs through three business units:

**Client Technology (CT) -** focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

**Information Security (Info Sec) -** Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  

**The opportunity**

As a Security Consultant within EY’s internal Global Information Security team, the individual will be a trusted security advisor to the Client Technology Platforms Delivery organization within IT Services. The Client Technology Platforms delivery organization is responsible for end-to-end delivery of technology programs and projects supporting EY’s Client Techmology service lines including delivery of a global managed services platform, big data and analytics solutions as well as individual line of business solutions and services. This role will directly engage in supporting a team of architects, engineers, and product managers for delivery on programs and projects, defining security risks and control, providing security guidance, identifying and prioritizing security-related requirements, promoting secure-by-default designs and facilitating delivery of information security services throughout the system development life cycle (SDLC). The role will also develop and directly communicate appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security vulnerabilities translated vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for communication to business stakeholders.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Support a technical team with a focus on the following responsibilities:
* Provide security architectures and provide pragmatic security guidance that balance business benefit and risks.
* Engage IT project teams throughout the SDLC to identify and prioritize applicable security controls and provide guidance on how to implement these controls
* Perform threat modeling and risk assessments of information systems, applications and infrastructure
* Maintain and enhance the Information Security risk assessment and certification methodologies
* Define security configuration standards for shared and multi-tenant platforms and technologies
* Develop appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security risks identified during security review or audit
* Translate technical vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for business units and recommend corrective actions to customers and project stakeholders
* Provide knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) in responsible technologies and have deep technical understanding of responsible services and technology portfolios

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

Significant working security experience and knowledge in the design, implementation, and operation of security controls in one of the following areas:

* **Cloud Security** – Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud-based solutions e.g., Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services or another cloud platform (GCP, AWS, IBM, AliCloud, etc.)
* **Infrastructure Security** – Experience with the integration of cloud native infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), Application and API Gateways, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* **Application Security** - Experience with the design and testing of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and microservices architecture.
* **Identity and Access Management** – Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design and integration with API, IDaaS, and Federation technologies.
* **Agile & DevSecOps Methodologies** – Experience promoting automated security features in pipelines and security testing as a central feature in Agile workflows as a contributing member within an Agile development or DevOps environment.

  

Although not required, it is preferred that candidates possess additional working security experience and knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

* **Operational Security** – Experience with defining operational security models and procedures for business solutions including the operation and maintenance of infrastructure and application security controls.
* **Information Security Standards** – Knowledge of common information security standards such as: ISO 27001/27002, CSA and CIS Controls, NIST CSF, PCI/DSS, FEDRAMP.
* **Product Management** – working with broader business and technology teams on aspects of security that affect all phases of PI Planning from concept to design to implementation and then operational support.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have:**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
* Candidates are preferred to hold or be actively pursuing related professional certifications within the GIAC family of certifications or CISSP, CISM or CISA or similar cloud-security oriented certifications.
* Five or more years of experience in the management of a significant Information Security risk management function
* Experience in managing the communication of security findings and recommendations to IT project teams, business leadership and technology management executives

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Exceptional judgment, tact, and decision-making ability
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
* Excellent , communication, organizational, and decision-making skills
* Strong English language skills are required

  

**What working at EY offers**

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate - Digital Delivery - T&I
description:
WSP are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead to drive digital transformation, BIM excellence, automation initiatives, and digital project delivery across our Transport & Infrastructure business.

The Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead is the strategic technology architect responsible for the comprehensive digital lifecycle of our major infrastructure, utility corridors, bridges, and infrastructure master plans. Operating across the entire delivery continuum from conceptual design to asset handover this role unifies BIM, Geospatial Intelligence (GIS), Real-time Digital Twins, Legacy CAD standardizations, High-End 3D Visualizations, and AI-driven workflow automations.

You will not just manage models; you will design the overarching data infrastructure that connects engineering design to operational asset management, ensuring absolute data integrity, efficiency, and future-proof project delivery.

  

**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

**1. Digital Strategy, Frameworks & BIM Governance**

* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching **Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP)** and **BIM Execution Plans (BEP)** in strict compliance with **ISO 19650** standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the **Common Data Environment (CDE)** using **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)** / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.
* Govern project coordinate systems, ensuring zero spatial or coordinate drift across linear highway alignments, utility networks, structural bridges, and global GIS maps.

**2. GIS & Digital Twin Integration**

* Architect the bidirectional data pipelines connecting **GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS / QGIS)** with horizontal engineering design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads).
* Build the schema maps and asset metadata frameworks required to translate 3D BIM data into operational **Digital Twin environments** (e.g., Autodesk Tandem, Bentley iTwin, or custom web-based twin environments).
* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future **IoT sensor data metadata placeholders** within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.

**3. CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows**

* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.

**4. 3D Visualization & Reality Capture**

* Manage large-scale visual aggregation models within **Autodesk InfraWorks** , Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine to produce high-end, real-time interactive models for public consultation and executive stakeholder reviews.
* Oversite the integration of **Reality Capture datasets** (UAV Photogrammetry, LiDAR point clouds, mobile scanning) into active design environments for real-time site verification.

**5. AI Tools, Scripting & Automations**

* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using **Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit** , Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement **AI-driven design tools** and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Information Management, Digital Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree would be advantageous
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
* Proven experience leading digital delivery on large-scale transport and infrastructure projects.
* Strong background supporting the design and delivery of:

  + Roads & Highways
  + Rail & Transit
  + Bridges and Structures
  + Utilities
  + Aviation
  + Smart Infrastructure Projects
* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
* Experience working in the UAE and/or wider Middle East strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.

**Technical Proficiencies:**

* BIM / Civil Design: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D (corridors, pipes, gradings), InfraWorks, and Revit (structures/bridges).
* Geospatial (GIS): Expert capability in Esri ArcGIS (Pro / Online) and its native integrations with the Autodesk ecosystem.
* Digital Twin & Visualization: Practical understanding of Digital Twin schemas (Asset Information Models) and real-time rendering environments (InfraWorks, Enscape, Twinmotion).
* Automation & Coding: Proficient with Dynamo, Python, or visual programming tools. Experience with AI prompt engineering or AI plugins for design optimization is highly valued.
* Collaboration & CAD: Mastery of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) alongside classic AutoCAD Architecture/Civil workflows.

**Job Description**

**The Future Begins Here**


At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.


Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company.
